notes.title: Lost Report v2.1 patch notes
notes.content:
Just a small update with some bug fixes.

-Added names for two songs in Echoes.
-Made the gun attack meter slower.
-Fixed an issue where the “Baldmayerology” achievement wasn’t triggering. If you’ve finished the quest, you can now trigger the achievement by talking to the guy you delivered the book to again.
-Fixed issues where you could clip into some walls.
-Fixed some issues with the virtual pet not appearing in a few scenes.
-Fixed a few typos.

notes.title: KOWLOON'S CURSE: LOST REPORT - 2.0 UPDATE RELEASE
notes.content:
It’s finally here.

Eight months after its initial release, we’re excited to announce that the 2.0 update for Kowloon’s Curse: Lost Report is out!

It took a bit a longer than expected, and we’re sorry for that, but the amount of content added in the update will surely make up for it!

So what’s new in this update, exactly?

-We weren’t entirely happy with how the story ended, so we’ve added a brand new storyline that gives Tony and Sergio the ending they deserve.

-Alongside this, the original storyline has received numerous improvements, such as new dialogue and balancing tweaks.

-In addition to the improved main story, we’ve also added several sidequests, fleshing out the game’s world and taking you to new areas.

-Battles now have intro cutscenes!

-Overall graphics quality has been improved, with lighting being completely redone and many characters receiving new models. 

-Many of the old areas have been expanded, and a bunch of new ones have been added, such as the sewers beneath Kowloon City.

-A virtual pet that grows when you walk!

-There’s also many new secrets, but I’m obviously not going to give those away here.

-Finally, a ton of bugs have been fixed, making the game much more stable than it was before.

That’s all!

Now, go and play the definitive version of Kowloon’s Curse: Lost Report, and leave a review if you enjoyed it!
